title: General improved Friedgut junta size term
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb N$, let $f$ be a Boolean function on $\{−1,1\}^n$ with values in $\{−1,1\}$, and let $\epsilon,\eta\in\mathbb R$. The general improved Friedgut junta size term is $\frac{I(f)^{2+\eta}}{\epsilon^{1+\eta}}\,C_{\mathrm{gen}}(\eta)^k$, where $I(f)$ is the total influence of $f$ and $C_{\mathrm{gen}}(\eta)=\left(\frac{2}{\eta}+1\right)^{1+\eta}$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function $f$ on $\{−1,1\}^n$ with values in $\{−1,1\}$
